The '''plant''' was from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibbela]], a primitive [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Tales" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.</ref> It had had a single stalk that grew a cylindrical, spiraling, [[Color/Legends|yellow]] crop, with white tufts at the top. The [[Plant|crop]] was supported by overlapping, dark green, pointed leaves.<ref name="Tales" /> The [[Dazouri]], Gibbela's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species,<ref name="Hiding in Plain Sight">{{SW|url=news/hiding-in-plain-sight-star-wars-shapeshifters|text=Hiding in Plain Sight: ''Star Wars'' Shapeshifters|int=Hiding in Plain Sight: Star Wars Shapeshifters|nolive=1}}</ref> cultivated the crop plants in concentric circles centered on groves of two or three [[Unidentified Gibbela fruit tree|fruit trees]]. These gardens were protected by [[Scarecrow/Legends|scarecrows]], and tended with [[Hoe/Legends|hoes]].<ref name="Tales" />

During the period of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperials [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] Gibbela as a possible site for colonization. Initial impressions suggested the local population would provide little in the way of resistance.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|340|Gibbela}}.</ref> Consequently, a small Imperial task force [[Mission to Gibbela|landed]] on the planet, with their [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] crushing several crop and [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] gardens. A local [[Unidentified Dazouri farmer|farmer]] retaliated and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Imperial task force, later converting some of their equipment to [[Farm/Legends|farming]] use.<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Ken Lizzl]] created this crop plant for the two-page [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[The Value of Proper Intelligence to Any Successful Military Campaign is Not to Be Underestimated]]," which was illustrated by [[Lucas Marangon]] and published in [[Star Wars Tales 19|''Star Wars Tales'' 19]]<ref name="Tales" /> on [[May 14]], [[2004]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-582/Star-Wars-Tales-19-Photo-cover|text=Star Wars Tales 19}}</ref> For volumes [[Star Wars Tales 1|one]] to [[Star Wars Tales 20|twenty]] of ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'', plausible stories were considered [[Canon|S-canon]] unless referenced in a non-''Tales'' source. If this occurred, the story would be elevated to C-canon.<ref name="Canon">{{Blog|holocron|56|starwars.com forum HolocronKeeper comments archive}}.</ref> The events of this comic received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', thus raising the events to C-canon.<ref name="CSWE" />
